verses.text: Yahweh told Moses, ‘Go to Pharaoh and tell him, “Yahweh says: Let my people go worship me. 📣
“‘If you refuse, I’m sending frogs all over your land. 🐸
“‘The river will swarm with frogs. They’ll come into your house, your bedroom, your bed, your officials’ homes, your people’s homes, your ovens, and your dough bowls. 🐸
“‘Frogs will come up over you, your people, and all your officials.”’ 🐸
Yahweh told Moses, ‘Tell Aaron: “Stretch your staff over Egypt’s rivers, streams, and pools, and make frogs come up over the land.”’ 🪄
Aaron stretched his hand over Egypt’s waters, and frogs came up and covered the land. 🐸
Egypt’s magicians did the same with their secret arts and brought frogs over Egypt too. 🎩
Then Pharaoh called Moses and Aaron and said, ‘Ask Yahweh to take the frogs away from me and my people. Then I’ll let the people go offer sacrifices to Yahweh.’ 🙏
Moses said to Pharaoh, ‘You decide when I should pray for you, your officials, and your people. When should the frogs leave you and your homes and stay only in the river?’ 🗓️
Pharaoh said, ‘Tomorrow.’ Moses replied, ‘It’ll happen as you say, so you’ll know there’s no one like Yahweh our God. 🌅
‘The frogs will leave you, your homes, your officials, and your people. They’ll remain only in the river.’ 🐸
Moses and Aaron left Pharaoh. Moses cried out to Yahweh about the frogs he had brought on Pharaoh. 🙏
Yahweh did what Moses asked. The frogs died in the houses, courtyards, and fields. 🐸
People piled the dead frogs into heaps, and the land stank. 🤢
But when Pharaoh saw there was relief, he became stubborn and wouldn’t listen to Moses and Aaron, just as Yahweh had said. 😠
Yahweh told Moses, ‘Tell Aaron: “Raise your staff and strike the ground. The dust will turn into lice throughout Egypt.”’ 🪄
They did it. Aaron stretched out his hand with his staff and struck the dust. Lice got on people and animals; all the dust across Egypt turned into lice. 🦟
The magicians tried using their secret arts to make lice too, but they couldn’t. Lice were on people and animals. 🦟
The magicians told Pharaoh, ‘This is God’s doing!’ But Pharaoh stayed stubborn and wouldn’t listen, just as Yahweh had said. ⚠️
Yahweh told Moses, ‘Get up early and stand before Pharaoh when he goes to the water. Tell him, “Yahweh says: Let my people go worship me. 🌅
“‘If you don’t let them go, I’ll send swarms of flies on you, your officials, and your people. Your homes will be full of flies, and they’ll cover the ground too. 🪰
“‘But that day I’ll set Goshen apart, where my people live. No flies will swarm there. Then you’ll know I, Yahweh, am here in this land. 🛡️
“‘I’ll make a clear distinction between my people and yours. This sign will happen tomorrow.”’ ✨
Yahweh did it. Huge swarms of flies filled Pharaoh’s palace and his officials’ homes. Flies ruined the whole land of Egypt. 🪰
Pharaoh called Moses and Aaron and said, ‘Go offer sacrifices to your God here in the land.’ 🗣️
Moses said, ‘That wouldn’t be right. What we sacrifice to Yahweh our God is detestable to the Egyptians. If we do it in front of them, won’t they stone us? ⚠️
‘We’ll travel three days into the wilderness and offer sacrifices to Yahweh our God, as he tells us.’ 🏜️
Pharaoh said, ‘I’ll let you go into the wilderness to offer sacrifices to Yahweh your God. Just don’t go very far. Pray for me.’ 🗣️
Moses said, ‘I’m leaving now. I’ll pray to Yahweh so the flies leave you, your officials, and your people tomorrow. But don’t trick us again by refusing to let the people go worship Yahweh.’ 🙏
Moses left Pharaoh and prayed to Yahweh. 🙏
Yahweh did what Moses asked and removed the flies from Pharaoh, his officials, and his people. Not one fly remained. 🪰
But Pharaoh became stubborn again and wouldn’t let the people go. 😠
